value.rationale: The natural first two Taylor-jet regularizers compete in a nonmonotone Lu Qi-Keng phenomenon: adding a positive derivative penalty can eliminate a kernel zero and a stronger penalty creates two. The complete inclusive two-parameter boundary gives a structurally useful criterion for kernel-zero avoidance, not merely a coefficient substitution or isolated numerical threshold.
